OR-E4.Description:
Implement the 'Buy from Oriflame' handoff through a single server-side ReferralService that uses only an official referral URL or a documented manual-code mechanism, plus basic click analytics.

SCOPE:
- ReferralService resolving official_url / manual_code / unavailable from configuration
- Referral host allow-list confirmed with the owner (ADR-002)
- referral_clicks storage without personal data
- Handoff API endpoint
- BuyFromOriflame and CopyReferralCode components on PDP and shopping list
- Referral / how-to-buy page

OUT OF SCOPE:
- Admin-editable referral settings or a settings database (status view only, OR-E6)
- Any claim of attributed sales
- On-site checkout or payment

REFERENCE DOCS:
- docs/REFERRAL.md
- backend/AGENT.md (Referral Service)
- docs/SECURITY.md (Referral Open-Redirect Prevention)

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- Referral configuration is read only from server-side environment variables
- The handoff uses a validated, configured official referral destination or provides manual-code instructions with a copy action
- No referral URL is constructed in UI components; client never supplies the destination
- Consultant code never appears in client bundles or NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables unless confirmed intentionally public
- No UI or API text claims a sale was attributed
- Backend and frontend gates pass

OR-E4.Summary: Confirm referral mechanism and record ADR-002
OR-E4.Description:
Confirm with the owner how Oriflame Pakistan attributes referrals before coding the handoff.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Confirm: official referral URL format supplied by Oriflame, or manual consultant-code entry at checkout, or both
- Confirm the exact official hosts permitted as referral destinations
- docs/adr/ADR-002-referral-method.md: decision, allowed hosts, whether the consultant code may be shown publicly (required for manual_code), evidence source
- Update the allow-list constant introduced in OR-002 and docs/REFERRAL.md

EFFORT: S (2 hours, plus owner response time)
PROJECT AREA: Docs / Research
DEPENDENCIES: OR-002

TESTING CRITERIA:
- ADR-002 indexed; allow-list in code matches ADR exactly

EDGE CASES:
- Mechanism unconfirmed: ADR Proposed; handoff ships in 'unavailable' mode with generic link to the official site homepage only if the owner approves, otherwise instructions only
- Never assume that appending a consultant code to an arbitrary URL creates attribution

Centralise all referral logic in one server-side service.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- backend/app/services/referral.py: ReferralService(config_provider).resolve() -> ReferralHandoff discriminated union: OfficialUrlHandoff(url), ManualCodeHandoff(code, instructions, checkout_url optional), UnavailableHandoff(reason)
- Re-validates https scheme and allow-listed host at resolve time (defence in depth)
- status() -> configured / not_configured / invalid for admin use (OR-E6), never returning the raw code
- Instruction text centralised (no attribution claims)

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-029

TESTING CRITERIA:
- official_url with valid config returns URL; invalid host returns Unavailable
- manual_code returns code and instructions
- Missing config returns Unavailable with reason not_configured
- Single-vendor configuration test: service obtains config only via ConfigProvider

EDGE CASES:
- Config changes between requests (restart): no cached stale handoff beyond settings lifecycle
- Referral URL with credentials, fragments, or non-default port: rejected
- Instruction text must not state or imply guaranteed attribution

Record handoff clicks for basic analytics without personal data.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Model ReferralClick (id, occurred_at, method official_url/manual_code/unavailable, origin pdp/list/referral_page, product_slug nullable, item_count) — no IP, user agent, or identifiers
- Alembic migration with index on occurred_at (RLS enabled, no policies — Supabase Data API lockdown per docs/DATABASE.md)
- repositories/referral_clicks.py: record(), daily_counts(range)

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Database
DEPENDENCIES: OR-030

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Migration reversible; no drift
- daily_counts aggregates correctly across days
- Schema review confirms no personal data columns

EDGE CASES:
- Click recording failure must not block the handoff (log and continue)
- Bot traffic: excluded via simple user-agent heuristic at request time (not stored) or documented as a known limitation

Expose the resolved handoff to the frontend.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- POST /api/v1/referral/handoff with body {origin, product_slug?, item_count} (no destination field accepted)
- Calls ReferralService.resolve(), records a click, returns the typed handoff union
- Rate limited; extra='forbid' request model
- Response Cache-Control: no-store

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-030, OR-031

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Each handoff variant returned correctly
- Body containing a 'url' or 'destination' field rejected (422)
- Click recorded per call; failure to record still returns handoff

EDGE CASES:
- Unknown product_slug: accepted for analytics as null, not an error that blocks buying
- item_count bounded (0–200)

Render the handoff in the UI using only server-resolved data.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- components/referral/BuyFromOriflame (Client Component): calls the handoff endpoint on click; for official_url opens the returned URL (rel='noopener noreferrer'); for manual_code opens an accessible dialog with instructions and CopyReferralCode; for unavailable shows a calm explanation
- CopyReferralCode: copies via Clipboard API with fallback selection; announces success to screen readers
- Wired into PDP (OR-025) and shopping list (OR-027)
- Text: checkout and fulfilment happen on Oriflame's official platform

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-032, OR-025, OR-027

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Vitest: each variant renders correctly; copy action works and is keyboard-accessible
- Static check: no referral URL string or consultant code in frontend source or build output
- Dialog traps focus and closes with Escape

EDGE CASES:
- Clipboard permission denied: code shown selected with 'press Ctrl+C' hint
- Pop-up blocked: fall back to same-tab navigation link
- Network error calling handoff: retry option, no guessed URL
